source_policy.uncertainty_rule: When authoritative sources disagree or exact same-session data are not independently verified, retain null and require same-date validation; do not silently blend or overwrite values.

breaking_news.headline: Hotter PCE keeps Fed tightening risk alive while Wall Street finishes nearly flat
breaking_news.summary: July PCE inflation rose 3.7% year over year, a touch above expectations; Q2 GDP was 1.5%. Dow fell 0.21%, S&P 500 0.02% and Nasdaq 0.08%.
breaking_news.market_impact: Treasury yields and the dollar moved higher; rate-sensitive growth remained restrained ahead of Nvidia results.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Higher yields cap valuation expansion in Taiwan electronics even as AI fundamentals remain strong.

breaking_news.headline: Nvidia beats Q2 estimates and guides Q3 revenue above consensus
breaking_news.summary: Nvidia Q2 revenue reached $96.22B and adjusted EPS $2.22; Q3 revenue guidance is $108B plus or minus 2%, above the $104.19B consensus.
breaking_news.market_impact: Confirms persistent AI infrastructure demand, though margins and China exposure remain key risks.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Strong read-through for TSMC, advanced packaging, AI servers, networking, PCB, cooling and power.

breaking_news.headline: WTI falls for a third session as Hormuz talks reduce geopolitical premium
breaking_news.summary: WTI settled near $82.23 as investors weighed Iran-Oman talks and a small U.S. crude inventory increase.
breaking_news.market_impact: Lower energy prices offset some inflation pressure, but July PCE remains sticky.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Lower oil supports transport and broad input costs; inflation/rates remain the bigger valuation driver.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Nvidia Q2 revenue doubles; Q3 guide tops Wall Street
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Revenue was $96.22B versus $92.17B expected; adjusted EPS $2.22 versus $2.10; data-center revenue $89B. Q3 revenue guide is $108B plus or minus 2%.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: AI demand remains robust and raises the floor for hyperscaler-capex expectations.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Directly positive for TSMC foundry, CoWoS/advanced packaging, ODM servers, networking, PCB, cooling and power.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Nvidia and AWS plan two million additional GPUs in 2027-2028
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Nvidia said AWS will deploy an additional two million Nvidia GPUs globally during 2027 and 2028.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Extends visibility of AI accelerator demand beyond the current fiscal year.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Supports longer-duration demand expectations across Taiwan AI hardware supply chain.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: AI competition broadens while megacaps remain mixed
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Reuters highlighted growing inference competition from AMD, Intel and in-house silicon. Apple rose about 1.1%; Microsoft closed higher; TSM ADR was approximately flat.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Strong Nvidia results coexist with increasing custom-silicon and inference competition.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Favor diversified exposure across foundry, advanced packaging, custom ASIC, server ODM and networking rather than a single GPU theme.

narration_points: 美股週三幾乎持平，但7月PCE年增3.7%略高於預期，10年期殖利率回升至4.663%，高估值科技仍受利率約束。
NVIDIA財報正式公布：Q2營收962.2億美元、調整後EPS 2.22美元均優於預期，Q3營收指引1080億美元也高於市場共識，AI需求主線仍在。
SOX逆勢上漲0.25%，TSM ADR近乎持平；真正的盤前焦點是NVIDIA財報後對台積電、CoWoS、AI伺服器、網通、PCB、散熱與電源的外溢效果。
WTI回落至82.23美元附近、黃金期貨約4653.3美元；能源風險降溫，但通膨黏性與Jackson Hole政策訊號仍是估值風險。
台股盤前仍要用美股RRG與台股Rotation做雙重確認，不因NVIDIA單一財報利多就無條件追價。
